prose: Dylan Saccoccio is back on Beltane (5/1) to demystify the magnificence of the Royal Stars: Aldebaran, Regulus, Antares and Fomalhaut, known as the guardians of the skies. Through the syncretic lens of Astrotheology, Dylan demonstrates how these four stars are the four seasons, the four evangelists (Luke, Mark, John, Matthew), and the four horsemen of the apocalypse. All this and much more.
